visual_synopsis: A young mother sits bored on a patterned sofa while her three small children watch cartoons on a CRT television in a wood-panelled living room. A nerdy man in a grey suit and glasses turns up by the mirror clutching a small cellophane-wrapped bunch of tulips and courts her with an eager pitch; she keeps giving him skeptical sidelong looks while the kids watch the two adults instead of the TV.
